notes: Authenticated as masenf through the local GitHub CLI and GitHub connector; the final listing contains 108 open PRs and all 76 non-drafts have fresh review/check state and local measurements.
Review and CI state came from authenticated GitHub REST and GraphQL reads; local git merge-tree supplied authoritative conflict status.
Git measurements and merge-tree use main b2e009a8266f44b1f4fa62008064d9a7229a817b; local merge-tree is authoritative for clean versus conflicting.

Waiting on maintainer requires a clean local merge, SUCCESS with at least 60 GitHub Actions checks, zero unresolved review threads, and newer author activity; PR creation is the baseline when no peer maintainer has interacted.
Every red or cancelled PR has a current log- or check-diagnostic-derived finding; superseded cancelled jobs with successful same-head replacements are not treated as substantive failures.
The label audit covered all 108 open PRs, drafts included; documentation requires real docs paths, while breaking labels require a current public-contract change.
audit_corrections: Recomputed peer-maintainer interaction from event roles; collector mismatches corrected: none.
Recomputed strict waiting membership from local merge, Actions depth, threads, and activity order; collector mismatches corrected: none.
Superseded failed or cancelled check attempts were removed from current-head blockers whenever GitHub’s status rollup was green.
#7413 and #7626 merged during the final reconciliation; main, all measurements, and all local merges were refreshed before publishing.

The adversarial audit restored all 30 conflict-file lists and conflict clusters, aligned scores with the documented rubric, removed multi-blocker PRs from one-fix-away, and narrowed fast lane to genuinely small diffs.
#7635 opened and #7415, #7558, #7592, and #7632 pushed while the audited snapshot was being finalized; those heads and all dependent measurements were refreshed.
caveats: Latest commit or timeline activity is used as the push-time proxy because the connector does not expose a separate pushed timestamp.
Workflow-gated fork PRs show only reviewer-bot checks; they are not classified as green until the full Actions suite runs.
Automated review threads are counted as open issues when unresolved, but bots never count as maintainer interaction.
Historical review commit ancestry remains unverified where force-pushed review SHAs are no longer reachable; current heads and counting approvals are verified.
